questions.prompt: An ACI group has two containers requesting one CPU each. One container has a limit of two CPUs. What does that limit allow?

options.text: Use up to two CPUs when available within the allocated group resources.
options.explanation: A limit permits borrowing available allocation; it does not expand the group beyond its requested capacity.

options.text: Automatically create a second container-group replica.
options.explanation: Container resource limits do not create replicas.

options.text: Reserve four CPUs for the group automatically.
options.explanation: The requests total two CPUs, not four.

options.text: Guarantee two dedicated CPUs for each container simultaneously.
options.explanation: Both containers cannot each consume two CPUs from a two-CPU allocation.

questions.prompt: A Container Apps queue worker has ingress disabled, minReplicas 0, and no custom scale rule. Why can it remain at zero while queue messages arrive?

options.text: No configured trigger observes the queue and requests replicas.
options.explanation: Without ingress or a custom event rule, queue arrivals do not wake the app.

options.text: maxReplicas always forces at least that many replicas to run.
options.explanation: Maximum is a limit, not the requested minimum.

options.text: Changing the image tag in ACR automatically processes the queue.
options.explanation: An image tag does not configure an event scaler.

options.text: The inactive replica can measure its own CPU and wake itself.
options.explanation: There is no running replica producing that utilization signal.

questions.prompt: Every Container Apps replica fails during startup because its memory allocation is too small. Which change directly addresses that failure?

options.text: Choose a supported larger per-replica memory allocation and deploy the revision.
options.explanation: Each replica needs enough memory to start successfully.

options.text: Raise only maxReplicas while preserving the insufficient allocation.
options.explanation: More failing replicas do not increase memory available to each process.

options.text: Lower minReplicas to zero and leave the image unchanged.
options.explanation: A lower minimum does not fix the startup memory requirement.

options.text: Change only the ingress traffic percentage.
options.explanation: Traffic distribution does not enlarge the container memory allocation.
